$comment: The cross-platform contract for Stance AI components. Web, iOS and Android implement the same names, parts, states and accessibility rules. Platform idioms decide the rest.
principles: Presentational and transport agnostic. No model SDK, no network calls. The app owns data and passes state in.
Streaming safe. Partial content never shifts layout above the reading position and never steals focus.
No new hues. AI surfaces use the ink scale; identity comes from motion, the sparkle icon and clear labelling.
Every animated state has a reduced motion form. Shimmer and pulse become a static state with text.
Screen readers hear status changes politely, once: started, finished, stopped, failed. Never each token.
Every visible string is a prop or label with an English default, so products can translate everything.
Right to left works without extra props.

status.$comment: Shared generation status used by several components.

components.name: Thread
components.summary: The scrolling container for a conversation. Sticks to the latest message while the reader is at the bottom and releases as soon as they scroll up.
components.a11y: A labelled log region. New complete messages are announced politely.

components.name: Message
components.summary: One turn in a conversation from the user, the assistant or the system.
components.a11y: An article named by author and time. aria-busy while streaming.

components.name: MessageGroup
components.summary: Consecutive messages from one author under a single avatar and name.

components.name: MessageActions
components.summary: The row of actions under a message: copy, retry, edit, good response, bad response.
components.a11y: A toolbar. Rating buttons are toggle buttons. Copy confirms with a polite announcement.

components.name: BranchSwitcher
components.summary: Steps between alternative versions of a message after an edit or retry.
components.a11y: Previous and next buttons with a live text of position, for example 2 of 3.

components.name: ScrollToLatest
components.summary: A floating button that appears when the reader has scrolled away from the newest message.

components.name: ConversationList
components.summary: A list of past conversations grouped by date, with selection, rename and delete.
props: items: { id, title, updatedAt, group?, pinned? }[]
components.a11y: A navigation list. The current conversation uses aria-current.

components.name: ThreadEmptyState
components.summary: The opening screen of a new conversation with a greeting and starter prompts.

components.name: PromptComposer
components.summary: The message input. A text area that grows with content, with slots for attachments, tools and the send or stop button.
props: submitOnEnter (default true; Shift Enter adds a line)
components.a11y: A labelled form. Send is disabled when empty. While streaming the same button is named Stop.

components.name: AttachmentTray
components.summary: The attachments on a draft or a sent message: files and images with progress, errors and remove.
props: items: { id, name, kind: image | file, size?, previewUrl?, progress?, error? }[]
components.a11y: A list. Each remove button names its file. Upload errors are announced.

components.name: MentionPicker
components.summary: A filterable list that opens from a trigger character to reference files, people or tools.
props: items: { id, label, description?, icon?, group? }[]
components.a11y: A listbox owned by the composer, with active descendant navigation. Escape closes.

components.name: SlashCommandMenu
components.summary: A command list that opens when the draft starts with a slash.
props: commands: { id, name, description?, icon?, shortcut? }[]
components.a11y: Same listbox pattern as MentionPicker.

components.name: ModelPicker
components.summary: Chooses the model for the next message, with a short description and capability badges.
props: models: { id, name, description?, badges?, disabled? }[]

components.name: ContextChips
components.summary: Shows what the assistant can see for this message, such as files, pages or selections, each removable.

components.name: VoiceInputButton
components.summary: A microphone button with idle, listening and processing states and a level indicator.
components.a11y: A toggle button. State changes are announced.

components.name: StopButton
components.summary: Stops a response that is being generated.

components.name: TokenBudgetMeter
components.summary: A compact meter of how much of the context or message limit is used, with a warning near the limit.
components.a11y: A meter with value text. Crossing the warning threshold is announced once.

components.name: StreamingText
components.summary: Reveals text as it arrives at a steady cadence with an optional caret, without reflowing what is already on screen.
components.a11y: Screen readers get the text once it is complete, not token by token. Reduced motion shows text instantly.

components.name: ThinkingIndicator
components.summary: Shows that the assistant is working before any text arrives, with an optional label and elapsed time.
components.a11y: A status. Reduced motion shows a static mark with the label.

components.name: ReasoningDisclosure
components.summary: A collapsible block for the assistant's reasoning. Open while thinking, collapsed to a summary when done.
components.a11y: A disclosure button with expanded state. The summary reads, for example, Thought for 12 seconds.

components.name: ShimmerText
components.summary: Text with a slow light sweep for in-progress labels such as Searching the web.
components.a11y: Plain text to assistive technology. No animation with reduced motion.

components.name: GenerationProgress
components.summary: Progress for longer generations such as images or documents: determinate or indeterminate, with a stage label.
components.a11y: A progressbar with value text. Stage changes are announced politely.

components.name: StreamingSkeleton
components.summary: Placeholder lines for a response that has been requested and has not started.

components.name: InterruptedState
components.summary: Marks a response that was stopped or failed part way, with retry and continue.
components.a11y: An alert for errors, a status for stopped.

components.name: CitationChip
components.summary: An inline numbered marker that links a claim to its source and previews it on hover, focus or tap.
props: source: { title, url?, domain?, favicon?, snippet? }
components.a11y: A link or button named Source 2: title. The preview is reachable by keyboard.

components.name: SourceList
components.summary: The sources behind an answer, as a compact row that expands to a full list.
props: sources: { id, title, url?, domain?, favicon?, snippet? }[]

components.name: SourcePreview
components.summary: A card for one source: title, site, snippet and a link to open it.

components.name: ConfidenceBadge
components.summary: States how sure the system is in words, never colour alone.

components.name: AIGeneratedLabel
components.summary: Marks content as written or edited by AI.

components.name: DisclaimerNote
components.summary: A quiet note under the composer or a response, such as a reminder to check important facts.

components.name: FeedbackBar
components.summary: Thumbs up or down, followed by optional reasons and a comment, then a thank you.
components.a11y: Toggle buttons, then a labelled group of reasons. Submission is announced.

components.name: ReportDialog
components.summary: A dialog to report a response with a category and details.

components.name: SensitiveContentGate
components.summary: Hides content behind a notice until the reader chooses to see it.
components.a11y: Hidden content is removed from the accessibility tree until revealed. Focus moves to it on reveal.
